name: Bright Feather
description: A bright feather charm with iridescent plumage, a light breeze shimmer, and playful airborne elegance.

name: Jingle Bell
description: A tiny jingle bell charm of polished brass, cheerful and tinkling like a guardian of the skies.

name: Falconer's Lure
description: A falconer's lure charm of braided leather and feather tassels, practical and swift for trained birds.

name: Crystal Prism
description: A silvered leaf pendant, delicately veined, capturing a breath of mountain air and dawn mist.

name: Phoenix Plume
description: A phoenix plume charm of flame-gold feathers and ember glow, radiant with rebirth and fiery grace.

name: Starlight Windsock
description: A starlight windsock charm of silver silk and constellations, fluttering with cosmic wind and gentle brilliance.

name: Shiny Pebble
description: A shiny pebble charm, smooth and river-polished, with a wet gleam like treasure from the streambed.

name: Cork Bobber
description: A cork bobber charm of buoyant driftwood and red paint, simple and cheerful as a fishing day.

name: Spiral Shell
description: A spiral shell charm with pearly ridges and seafoam tint, echoing tides and hidden currents.

name: Glowing Coral
description: A glowing coral charm of silver-tinged bioluminescent branches, softly lit with reef-born magic.

name: Deep Pearl
description: A deep pearl charm, lustrous and mysterious, with gold-tinged abyssal sheen and ocean-deep elegance.

name: Abyssal Gem
description: An abyssal gem charm of star-metal blue crystal, faintly luminous like moonlight beneath the waves.

name: Tallow Candle
description: A hand-dipped wax candle charm, its flame a wisp of spectral blue, flickering with memories.

name: Carved Bone
description: A moon-pale mask charm, delicately etched with sigils, carrying an aura of mystery and faded laughter.

name: Black Ribbon
description: A black ribbon charm flowing like a silent wisp, eerie, delicate, and hauntingly graceful.

name: Soul Lantern
description: A soul lantern charm glowing with silver ectoplasm, ornate and spectral with a gentle wraithlight.

name: Shadow Crystal
description: A tiny locket containing silvered dust, chained with links of iron and worn by those who commune with spirits.

name: Void Shard
description: A void shard charm of star-metal-black crystal and starless depth, cold and uncanny.

name: Old Stick
description: A weathered driftwood piece, carved with tide-marks and wrapped gently in sea-grass cord full of found magic.

name: Knuckle Bone
description: A knuckle bone charm of polished bone and cord wrap, simple and talismanic with a folk-amulet feel.

name: Rabbit's Foot
description: A rabbit's foot charm of soft fur and stitched luck, a classic token of good fortune.

name: Silver Bell
description: A sturdy acorn charm, capped in copper and painted with protective symbols, prized by wanderers and wayfarers.

name: Enchanted Plushie
description: An enchanted plushie charm of soft fabric and glowing seams, cuddly, whimsical, and spellbound.

name: Cosmic Bauble
description: A cosmic bauble charm of swirling nebula glass and star-metal sparkles, tiny and infinitely wondrous.

name: Bat
description: A tiny bat with copper wings, velvet fur, and a twitchy caveborn flutter.

name: Raven
description: A bronze raven with glossy feathers, a beady stare, and an omened croak.

name: Owl
description: A silent owl with iron-gray plumage, wide amber eyes, and a patient nightwatch posture.

name: Hawk
description: A silver hawk with razor wings, bright talons, and a hunter's clear sky focus.

name: Harpy
description: A gold-feathered harpy with elegant claws, sweeping wings, and a fierce wind-carved silhouette.

name: Phoenix
description: A star-metal phoenix with flameglass plumage, blazing crest, and an immortal sunrise aura.

name: Rat
description: A scrappy rat with copper fur, quick whiskers, and a bold scavenger's attitude.

name: Ferret
description: A bronze ferret with a sleek body, dark mask, and darting ribbonlike movements.

name: Fox
description: A small fox with iron-red fur, sharp ears, and a clever woodland stare.

name: Shadowcat
description: A silver-shadowcat with velvet-black fur and moonlit eyes glowing from the dark.

name: Moonhare
description: A gold moonhare with luminous fur, delicate ears, and a dreamy hop through twilight grass.

name: Kitsune
description: A star-metal kitsune with nine glassy tails, ornate markings, and an aura of ancient trickster magic.

name: Glowmoth
description: A tiny glowmoth with coppery wings and a soft lantern-like shimmer in the dusk.

name: Crystal Lizard
description: A bronze crystal lizard with faceted scales, bright eyes, and a desert gem sparkle.

name: Living Grimoire
description: A compact living grimoire with leather-bound covers, brass corners, and twitching enchanted pages.

name: Blink Hound
description: A silver blur of a blink hound with prismatic fur and a sudden pop of spatial magic.

name: Mandrake
description: A gold-leaf mandrake with root-legs, expressive face, and a small chorus of herbal mischief.

name: Astral Familiar
description: A star-metal astral familiar with glassy wings, constellation markings, and a quiet orbit of cosmic light.

name: Wisp
description: A pale wisp with copper sparks, a drifting lantern glow, and a feather-light haunting flutter.

name: Fairy
description: A bright fairy with bronze wings, petal-soft dress, and a cheerful ring of forest magic.

name: Sprite
description: A tiny sprite with iron-green sheen, acorn cap, and a sparkling prankster grin.

name: Homunculus
description: A silver homunculus with stitched charm, glass beads, and a diligent little alchemical body.

name: Djinn
description: A gold djinn with swirling smoke, ornate ornaments, and a radiant command of wishfire.

name: Seraph
description: A star-metal seraph with feathered glass wings, sacred brilliance, and a face of serene dawn.

name: Crab
description: A small crab with copper shell, sharp claws, and a sideways skitter across wet stone.

name: Otter
description: A sleek otter with bronze fur, bright eyes, and playful riverbank energy.

name: Octopus
description: A compact octopus with dusky metal sheen, curling arms, and curious ink-dark intelligence.

name: Selkie
description: A silver-skinned selkie with shimmering sealskin, sea-glass accents, and a wistful shoreline presence.

name: Siren
description: A gold-haired siren with pearl scales, luminous eyes, and an enchanting tide-born elegance.

name: Water Elemental
description: A star-metal water elemental with flowing glass limbs, rippling currents, and a body of living moonlit water.

name: Witch Toad
description: A squat witch toad with mossy copper skin, warted charm, and a damp little curse in its gaze.

name: Imp
description: A bronze imp with tiny horns, bat wings, and a mischievous ember-eyed grin.

name: Hellhound
description: A lean hellhound with iron-black fur, glowing embers between the teeth, and a fiery stalking step.

name: Wraith
description: A silver wraith with torn mist-ribbons, hollow eyes, and a chilling presence like grave wind.

name: Shadow Demon
description: A gold-edged shadow demon with smoky limbs, jagged horns, and a regal nightmare silhouette.

name: Abyssal Horror
description: A star-metal abyssal horror with glassy eyes, void-dark flesh, and impossible angles from the deep.

name: Lost Soul
description: A dim lost soul with copper haze, drifting form, and a sorrowful echo of forgotten life.

name: Poltergeist
description: A bronze poltergeist with rattling chains, flickering edges, and a mischievous spectral shove.

name: Ancestral Shade
description: A silver ancestral shade with dignified robes of mist and a gentle guardian's gaze.

name: Banshee
description: A gold-lit banshee with flowing ethereal hair, sharp mournful beauty, and stormy funeral air.

name: Revenant
description: A star-metal revenant with cracked armor, ghost-fire seams, and an unyielding undeath.

name: Lich
description: A regal lich with a crown of bone and gold, skeletal poise, and a throne-born aura of cold sorcery.
